source_note: NGN. Figures printed in naira million in the audited consolidated and separate statement of cash flows, First HoldCo Plc annual report for the year ended 31 December 2025, page 66 (Group columns). Rebuilt 2026-11-13: the previous file's columns were shifted against the statement - its FY2025 investing cash flow was the Company 2024 figure and its FY2024 investing figure was neither printed column. Older columns (FY2023 to FY2021) were dropped rather than carried, because they cannot be reconciled to the printed statement. Every row ties: operating plus investing plus financing equals the net movement in cash in both years.

rebuild.verifiedAgainst: audited consolidated and separate statement of cash flows, First HoldCo annual report FY2025 page 66
